ambiguous_control_requires_review.rationale: The bounded source packet is insufficient to resolve the control.

external_dependency_trust_requires_conte.rationale: External dependency trust cannot be resolved from the bounded source fragment alone.

missing_emergency_stop.rationale: Absence of an emergency stop increases incident containment time but does not by itself prove asset loss.

rounding_to_zero_value_loss.rationale: Rounding can destroy user value or create systematic accounting drift.

tx_origin_authorization.rationale: tx.origin authorization enables phishing-style call-chain abuse.

unchecked_low_level_call.rationale: Unchecked call failure can leave state inconsistent with intended execution.

unbounded_loop_dos.rationale: Unbounded iteration can make a required operation exceed the block gas limit.

timestamp_as_randomness.rationale: Block timestamp is partially controllable and unsuitable as sole randomness.

predictable_block_randomness.rationale: Predictable block-derived values can be biased or anticipated by adversaries.

permit_without_deadline_or_domain.rationale: Missing expiry or domain binding broadens replay and cross-context use.

mempool_front_run_exposure.rationale: Public transaction intent can be copied or reordered before inclusion.

fee_on_transfer_accounting_mismatch.rationale: Nominal transfer amounts can diverge from received balances and break solvency accounting.

external_call_before_state_update.rationale: An external call before effects can re-enter while stale state is authoritative.

external_hook_before_accounting.rationale: A token or receiver hook can re-enter before internal accounting is finalized.

initializer_replay_or_takeover.rationale: Re-initialization can transfer privileged ownership or reset critical state.

user_controlled_delegatecall.rationale: Delegatecall to a user-controlled target executes attacker code in the caller storage context.

manipulable_spot_oracle.rationale: A manipulable spot price can corrupt collateral, minting or settlement decisions.

donation_share_price_manipulation.rationale: Direct asset donation can distort share price and transfer value between users.

unrestricted_mint.rationale: Unrestricted minting can arbitrarily dilute holders or create unbacked supply.

signature_replay_no_nonce_domain.rationale: Missing nonce and domain separation permits replay across calls or contexts.

upgrade_storage_layout_collision.rationale: Storage layout collision can corrupt privileged and user state after upgrade.

destructive_admin_capability.rationale: A privileged destructive path can permanently disable the contract or assets.

privileged_transfer_bypasses_policy.rationale: A privileged bypass invalidates policy guarantees and can selectively move restricted balances.

withdrawal_without_solvency_check.rationale: Withdrawals without a solvency invariant can leave liabilities undercollateralized.

unsafe_governance_quorum.rationale: Unsafe quorum rules can allow a small or flash-borrowed voting set to control governance.

message_domain_not_bound_to_chain_or_sen.rationale: Missing chain and sender domain binding permits cross-domain message replay.

default.rationale: No current policy classification exists; do not infer a stronger severity.

truthBoundary: This registry normalizes severity for local benchmark fixtures. It is not detector-quality proof or a guarantee that the same severity applies to a deployed contract without context.
